claims.statement: WireMock documents delayed responses and abrupt connection faults for isolated API testing.
claims.locator: Per-stub fixed delays and Bad responses
claims.rationale: WireMock documents fault injection models applied in the Node lab.

claims.statement: HTTP 503 is a temporary service-unavailable response and may include Retry-After.
claims.rationale: RFC 9110 defines 503 and retry pacing semantics.

claims.statement: HTTP 429 indicates rate limiting and may carry Retry-After.
A payment timeout may hide a processed transaction and blind resubmission risks duplicates.
claims.locator: Transaction Timeout Guidance and Retry/Duplicate Transaction Prevention
claims.rationale: Payment processor guidelines recommend outcome lookup before retry.

claims.statement: Node HTTP can create a local listening server and destroy a transport socket.
claims.rationale: Native runtime supports observable local HTTP fault injection.
